description: Contract-first interface for Initiative 11 (governed extension platform). Initiative 09 provider contracts plug in as permissions.network.destinations entries; Initiative 10 packaging consumes packaging.* and the signing envelope. Unknown capabilities are rejected, never silently dropped.

packaging.description: Consumed by Initiative 10 packaging: signature envelope, provenance, upgrade policy.

data.description: Closed vocabulary of data scopes. Request least privilege.

destinations.description: Explicit allowlist of bare hostnames. Empty = no network.

pii.description: redact (default): PII fields are masked before reaching extension code. read: full PII; requires registry UX-gate justification.

fs_roots.description: Relative paths inside the extension dir the extension may read/write. Default: none.

title: Veto extension manifest (v1) — published interface contract
